description:
Remove the item-kind copies from command and domain unit tests.

## Background

`CANONICAL_ITEM_KINDS` is hand-copied in the test modules of `crates/jit/src/commands/item.rs` (`:570`, with its `D-[0-9]+` pattern at `:581`) and `crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs` (`:2975`, pattern at `:2986`). `crates/jit/src/domain/item.rs` tests hard-code the decision kind's `D-[0-9]+` pattern (`:1633`, `:2087`). Shared test support derives the shipped item kinds from `profiles/jit-default/manifest.toml`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Unit tests in `commands/item.rs`, `commands/validate.rs` and `domain/item.rs` that need shipped kinds take them from the shared derivation.
- [hard] REQ-02: A test that needs a kind the package does not ship declares a minimal literal, and its name or comment says the kind is custom.
- [hard] REQ-03: No unit test under `crates/jit/src` restates a shipped kind's declaration or its id pattern.
title: Command unit tests take shipped item kinds from the default package
